reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: neither p0014 (invoicing/supporting detail owed to Company) nor p0007 (Contractor personnel must follow Company security/system-access policies) grants Contractor any audit, inspection or verification right against Customer, and p0007(ii) is a restriction on the counterparty rather than a grant of access to our systems.

No redline or comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed — consistent with the minimal-edit principle; inserting frequency/notice/cost caps would gratuitously create a Vendor audit right the bargain currently omits.
The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is correctly treated as a heuristic false signal: with no audit clause present there is nothing for the frequency-cap regex to match.

Rationale appropriately flags residual risk that a future Statement of Work could introduce a usage-verification right, with the preferred position (12-month frequency, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost unless >5% underpayment, no system access) noted for that contingency.
